newsitem.title: ZIMBABWE: ZIMBABWE DOLLAR CLOSES WEAKER UNDER PRESSURE.
newsitem.headline: ZIMBABWE DOLLAR CLOSES WEAKER UNDER PRESSURE.

text.p: The Zimbabwe dollar closed weaker against hard currencies on Monday under import pressure, dealers said.
"We saw the Zimbabwe dollar continue to weaken on the back of importer demand," commented a dealer.
"We're not seeing that many inflows at the moment," another said earlier on in the day.
The local unit finished the day at 11.2000/2100 against the U.S. dollar, two cents down from where it ended last Friday.
Against the crosses, the Zimbabwe dollar was also quoted easier, at 17.8270/8550 from 17.8200/8400 versus sterling and at 6.6080/6180 on the mark from 6.5500/5700.
It was also indicated marginally weaker on the rand at 2.5240/5400 compared to last Friday's 2.51005300.
